tools.name: Afina
tools.tagline: One of the few anti-detects originally built for crypto and working with projects
tools.description: One of the few anti-detects originally built for crypto and working with projects. Beautiful and convenient interface with very good performance - it genuinely runs faster than other browsers and personally for me this is the best anti-detect right now. From a Ukrainian team. The main feature is that there are simply no cloud saves here, and browser updates are installed only with your consent, not automatically. These are actually the main reasons how other services get hacked. They thought of this here, and also added the most convenient automator for creating your own scripts - better than BAS or Zenno and easier to figure out.

tools.description: One of the most popular anti-detects in the world from a Chinese team with their own SunBrowser profiles. Convenient API for Selenium/Puppeteer, team sync, built-in proxy manager and RPA robot for automation which, while not the most convenient, still works well. The problem is that ADS consumes a lot of RAM and running many profiles simultaneously will be problematic, and in January 2025 there was a hack for $4.7M from users through crypto wallet substitution and a malicious update, after which security wasn't improved much. If you continue using it, at least completely disable everything related to cloud sync and automatic updates in settings.

tools.name: Chrome DIY
tools.tagline: You can simply turn regular Chrome into a poor man's anti-detect
tools.description: You can simply turn regular Chrome into a poor man's anti-detect. Install [SwitchyOmega](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/proxy-switchyomega-3-zero/pfnededegaaopdmhkdmcofjmoldfiped) for proxy switching, [WebRTC Control](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/webrtc-control/fjkmabmdepjfammlpliljpnbhleegehm) to block IP leaks, [Canvas Blocker](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/canvas-blocker-fingerprin/nomnklagbgmgghhjidfhnoelnjfndfpd) for fingerprint spoofing, and [User-Agent Switcher](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/user-agent-switcher-for-c/djflhoibgkdhkhhcedjiklpkjnoahfmg) to change your UA. In chrome://flags disable WebRTC, in Settings turn off all "predictive" features. Fair warning: this is NOT a real anti-detect. GPU, audio and TLS fingerprints of Chrome remain stable, extensions are visible via navigator.plugins, and there's no session isolation. Good enough for basic privacy and simple tasks and nobody will steal your data not through your own mistake, but for serious multi-accounting use a proper anti-detect browser.

tools.name: Firefox DIY
tools.tagline: Firefox is actually the best browser for DIY anti-detect - way more customizable t...
tools.description: Firefox is actually the best browser for DIY anti-detect - way more customizable than Chrome, although it's harder and not as convenient. Install [FoxyProxy](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/foxyproxy-standard/) for proxy management. In about:config set media.peerconnection.enabled to false (completely kills WebRTC, which Chrome can't do), privacy.resistFingerprinting to true (built-in fingerprint protection), geo.enabled to false, network.dns.disablePrefetch to true. For the full package, install [arkenfox user.js](https://github.com/arkenfox/user.js/) - hundreds of privacy settings in one config file, 12K+ stars on GitHub. Add Canvas Blocker extension on top. Still not a real anti-detect with session isolation, but this is the maximum you can get for free. If these settings seem complicated, go to your AI and ask to explain in more detail, it won't take that much time.

tools.name: Brave DIY
tools.tagline: Brave is the easiest option - most of the work is already done for you out of the box
tools.description: Brave is the easiest option - most of the work is already done for you out of the box. Go to Settings > Privacy > Fingerprinting blocking and set it to Strict. Shields are on by default and block trackers. For WebRTC: Settings > Privacy > WebRTC IP handling policy > "Disable non-proxied UDP". For proxies install [SwitchyOmega](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/proxy-switchyomega-3-zero/pfnededegaaopdmhkdmcofjmoldfiped) (Chrome extensions work in Brave). It also has a built-in Tor mode for separate windows. Turn off Brave Rewards and telemetry in settings. The simplest setup of all three - less flexibility than Firefox, but you get solid privacy with almost zero effort. But remember this is still not a full replacement for an anti-detect and if you have a lot of accounts, buy a subscription to the anti-detect you like.

tools.name: GeeLark
tools.tagline: Cloud Android phones from the same team that brought you ADS Power - because appar...
tools.description: Cloud Android phones from the same team that brought you ADS Power - because apparently one way to lose your crypto wasn't enough. Jokes aside, the idea is actually good: instead of spoofing browser fingerprints, you get real ARM-based Android devices running in the cloud with unique IMEI, MAC, and hardware fingerprints. Perfect for TikTok, Instagram, and anything that sniffs out desktop anti-detects. RPA automation, synchronizer for bulk actions, API, Android 9-15 on demand. The pricing model is weird though - you pay per profile PLUS per minute of cloud phone usage ($0.007/min with a $1.20/day cap), so the real cost can creep up fast if you're not careful. Expensive, but if you need genuine mobile fingerprints and not desktop emulation - this is one of the few options that actually works.

tools.tagline: Was the 2nd biggest exchange. Collapsed in Nov 2022, crashed the whole market. SBF got ...
tools.description: Once the second largest crypto exchange in the world. Founded by Sam Bankman-Fried, reached $32B valuation, sponsored the Miami Heat arena, bought Super Bowl ads, and then spectacularly collapsed in November 2022 when it turned out they were using customer funds to cover losses at Alameda Research. The crash wiped billions off the crypto market and dragged BTC from $21K to $15K. SBF got 25 years in prison. The exchange that taught an entire generation to never trust "trust me bro" and to always keep their coins off exchanges. Gone but never forgotten.

tools.description: The industry standard hardware wallet. Your private keys are stored on a secure chip inside the device and never leave it, which means even if your computer is completely compromised, your crypto is safe. Supports thousands of coins across all major chains. The Nano S Plus starts at $79, the Nano X with Bluetooth at $149. Yes, it's annoying to plug in a USB stick every time you want to sign a transaction. But it's way less annoying than watching your life savings disappear because you clicked the wrong link. Keep at least a portion of your money on wallets like this so it's not always sitting hot in the browser - this is really important!

tools.description: Two-factor authentication app that does something Google Authenticator still refuses to do properly - cloud backups. If your phone breaks, drowns, or gets stolen, you don't lose access to 47 accounts. Multi-device sync means you can have your 2FA codes on your phone and tablet simultaneously. Use this or at least export your Google Authenticator codes somewhere.

tools.tagline: Disk encryption for the paranoid. Create encrypted containers or encrypt entire drives....
tools.description: Free open-source disk encryption software. Create encrypted containers (virtual drives) or encrypt entire partitions and drives. Uses AES, Twofish, Serpent or combinations. The reason this exists in a crypto security section: if someone steals your laptop or seizes your computer, they get nothing. Your seed phrases, private keys, password databases, everything stays encrypted. Deniable encryption feature lets you have a hidden volume inside a visible one. Not the most user-friendly tool, but the peace of mind is worth it.

supporting_tools.description: One Apple account with iCloud+ (starts at $0.99/month) lets you create up to 500 email aliases through Hide My Email. These are real, persistent Apple-backed addresses that forward to your main inbox, and they actually look legit to any service checking your email domain. Compare that to buying packs of Rambler, Mail.ru or other bottom-tier mailboxes that get banned on sight by half the platforms out there. For less than a dollar a month you get 500 clean emails that don't scream "throwaway account" and don't die randomly. Honestly one of the most underrated tools for multi-accounting.

For general research, learning, and coding questions where privacy isn't critical, it's an absurdly good free option. V3 is their latest for general chat and it's fast.

supporting_tools.description: Google's sleeper hit that turns your documents into a personal AI expert. Upload research papers, notes, YouTube video links, websites, or Google Docs - and NotebookLM creates an AI that only knows about YOUR sources. No hallucinations from random internet data, just grounded answers from the material you provided. The Audio Overview feature is pure magic - it generates a realistic podcast-style conversation between two hosts discussing your documents, complete with natural banter and insights. Completely free. Ridiculously useful for students, researchers, or anyone who needs to deeply understand a pile of documents without actually reading every page.

A relatively small model that competes with much larger ones specifically on code generation, debugging, and technical reasoning tasks. Fast, lean, and free to use. Doesn't try to be everything to everyone - it focuses on code and does it well. Great for quick coding questions, function generation, and debugging sessions where you don't need the full power of a GPT-4 class model. Proof that throwing more parameters at a problem isn't always the answer.

supporting_tools.description: Microsoft's image generation model (MAI Image 2) that quietly became one of the most capable generators around. Excellent at following detailed prompts precisely - if you describe a specific composition, lighting, and style, it delivers exactly that rather than its own interpretation. Integrated across Microsoft's consumer products: Copilot, Designer, Bing Image Creator. This means you can generate images for free through any of these interfaces. The consistency and prompt adherence make it particularly useful for professional work where you need predictable, high-quality output rather than artistic surprises.

supporting_tools.tagline: ByteDance's AI image generator that excels at text rendering in images - something most...
supporting_tools.description: ByteDance's (TikTok parent company) image generator that solved one of AI's hardest problems - rendering text in images correctly. While other models still produce gibberish when you ask for text on a poster or logo, Seedream actually writes readable words with proper typography. This makes it uniquely useful for social media graphics, marketing banners, meme templates, and any visual content where text matters. The image quality itself is also strong. Free to use on their platform. If you've ever rage-quit Midjourney because it turned your carefully worded text prompt into alien hieroglyphics, Seedream is the antidote.

supporting_tools.tagline: Black Forest Labs' open-source image model that became the go-to for developers buildin...
supporting_tools.description: Black Forest Labs' open-source image model that became the industry standard for developers building AI image products. Flux 2 is their latest and it's genuinely stunning - detailed, coherent, and stylistically versatile. Because it's open-source, you'll find it powering half the AI art platforms you've already used without knowing it. Available through their official API, plus dozens of third-party services like Replicate, fal.ai, and ComfyUI. Free for personal use through community platforms. Paid API access for commercial projects. The go-to choice if you want control over the generation process and don't want to be locked into one company's walled garden.

supporting_tools.description: Google DeepMind's video generation model that produces genuinely cinematic output. Veo 2 can generate coherent, high-quality video clips up to 4K resolution with realistic physics, lighting, and camera movements. The results are a clear step above most competitors - smooth motion, consistent characters, and actual understanding of how the physical world works. Available through Google's Vertex AI platform and integrated into some Google products. Not cheap for serious usage, but the quality gap is real. If you need AI-generated video that doesn't look like an AI-generated video, Veo is currently at the frontier.

supporting_tools.description: Alibaba's open-source video generation model that democratizes AI video. You can run it locally on your own hardware, which means no per-generation fees, no content restrictions, and no sending your creative work to someone else's servers. Generate videos from text descriptions or animate existing images. The quality genuinely competes with commercial offerings like Runway and Pika. Since it's open-source, the community has already created optimized versions, custom fine-tunes, and integration plugins for popular tools. Perfect for experimenting with AI video, building prototypes, or creating content at scale without the API bill making you cry.

supporting_tools.tagline: For me this is not just an anti-detect but the best automator out there. Built-in web3 ...
supporting_tools.description: I wrote about this anti-detect in detail in the corresponding section of the site. Here I'll just repeat - for me this is not just an anti-detect but the highest quality and most convenient automator for everything imaginable, which is easy to figure out and has official guides including on YT. There are many built-in solutions for web3 software right in the editor, like wallet logins or exchange withdrawals. Everything also runs on Afina profiles, meaning accounts don't get detected by sites like with other services, everything is done properly.
supporting_tools.description_md: One of the few anti-detects originally built for crypto and working with projects. Beautiful and convenient interface with very good performance - it genuinely runs faster than other browsers and personally for me this is the best anti-detect right now. From a Ukrainian team. The main feature is that there are simply no cloud saves here, and browser updates are installed only with your consent, not automatically. These are actually the main reasons how other services get hacked. They thought of this here, and also added the most convenient automator for creating your own scripts - better than BAS or Zenno and easier to figure out.

Здесь же лишь повторюсь - для меня это не только антидетект, а самый качественный и удобный автоматизатор всего что только можно, в котором легко разобраться и есть официальные гайды в том числе на YT. Есть множество встроенных решений для web3 софтов прямо в редакторе, например логин в кошельки или выводы с бирж. Также всё работает на профилях Afina, то есть аккаунты не детектятся сайтами как с другими сервисами, всё делается по красоте.

categories.name: Прокси
categories.description: Residential, mobile, ISP, and datacenter proxy rotation networks used for web intelligence, scraping, and anti-ban routing.

guide.content:
Датацентровые (DC) прокси — самый дешёвый вариант ($0.05-2/мес). Быстрые и стабильные, но легко вычисляются. Подходят для простого парсинга и мониторинга цен.

Резидентские прокси — реальные IP домашних пользователей ($1-8/ГБ). Сайты видят вас как обычного пользователя. Основной выбор для работы с антидетект-браузерами, крипто-активностями и соцсетями.

Мобильные прокси — IP мобильных операторов ($10-50/день). Самый «чистый» тип прокси: операторы делят один IP между тысячами абонентов, поэтому платформы их практически не банят. Идеально подходят под соцсети и строгий антифрод.

ISP прокси — статические прокси от реальных провайдеров ($2-5/мес). Долгосрочный постоянный IP с высоким уровнем доверия.

Datacenter (DC) proxies — the cheapest option ($0.05-2/mo). Fast and stable, but easy to detect. Good for simple scraping and price monitoring.

guide.content:
Пайплайн GenAI 3D за 4 шага:

1. Генерация. Meshy (PBR + Unity-плагин) для пропов, Tripo AI для быстрых черновиков за 8 секунд, Rodin/Hyper3D для фотореалистичных hero-моделей.

2. Проверка меша. Сырые ИИ-меши содержат 80k–120k треугольников — в мобильную игру их напрямую нельзя.

3. Чистка в Blender. Обязательный middleman-проход: см. гайд категории «Гейм-движки».

4. Импорт в движок. glTF + текстуры → Unity 6 URP с перепаковкой ORM-каналов.

Ловушка: никогда не пропускайте ретопологию — 100k+ треугольников убивают мобильный FPS.

2. Проверка меша. Сырые ИИ-меши содержат 80k–120k треугольников — в мобильную игру их напрямую нельзя.

3. Чистка в Blender. Обязательный middleman-проход: см. гайд категории «Гейм-движки».

4. Импорт в движок. glTF + текстуры → Unity 6 URP с перепаковкой ORM-каналов.

Ловушка: никогда не пропускайте ретопологию — 100k+ треугольников убивают мобильный FPS.

guide_en.button: How to generate 3D models with AI?
guide_en.content:
The GenAI 3D pipeline in 4 steps:

1. Generation. Meshy (PBR + Unity plugin) for props, Tripo AI for 8-second drafts, Rodin/Hyper3D for photoreal hero assets.

2. Mesh inspection. Raw AI meshes carry 80k–120k triangles — never ship them straight into a mobile game.

3. Cleanup in Blender. The mandatory middleman pass — see the Game Engines category guide.

4. Engine import. glTF + textures into Unity 6 URP with ORM channel repacking.

Trap: never skip retopology — 100k+ triangles destroy mobile FPS.

guide.content:
Vibe-coding конвейер из 3 этапов:

1. Прототип UI в v0. Опишите экран промптом, получите React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui.

2. Скаффолдинг в Lovable. Перенесите UI, добавьте схему Supabase, аутентификацию и Edge Functions промптами.

3. Продакшн-полировка в Cursor. AST-рефакторинг, мультифайловые правки, git-доставка.

Правило Small Files: один файл = одна ответственность, строго < 150 строк — код остается читаемым и не ломает сам себя.

Ловушка: файлы длиннее 200 строк, сгенерированные ИИ, начинают конфликтовать друг с другом.

guide_en.button: How to build apps from prompts?
guide_en.content:
The 3-stage vibe-coding pipeline:

1. UI prototype in v0. Describe a screen with a prompt, get React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui.

2. Scaffolding in Lovable. Bring the UI over, add a Supabase schema, auth, and Edge Functions via prompts.

3. Production hardening in Cursor. AST-aware refactoring, multi-file edits, git-native delivery.

Small Files rule: one file = one responsibility, strictly < 150 lines — code stays readable and never breaks itself.

Trap: AI-generated files longer than 200 lines start conflicting with each other.

guide.content:
Blender Middleman — обязательные 5 шагов чистки ИИ-мешей:

1. Non-manifold очистка: Merge by Distance 0.0001m + удаление вырожденных граней.
2. Десятирация / Quad Remesh: пропы ≤ 1 000 треугольников.
3. Нормализация пивота: Origin to Bottom (контакт с полом, Y = 0).
4. Перепаковка текстур: glTF ORM → Unity URP Lit.
5. Экспорт glTF + префаб drag & drop в Unity 6.

SoDog полигональный бюджет:
• Сцена целиком: ≤ 49 600 tris
• Hero-проп: ≤ 4 200 tris
• Стандартный проп: 250–1 000 tris
• Мелкий интерактив: ≤ 250 tris
• Hero-персонаж (LOD0): ≤ 8 500 tris

Формула перепаковки glTF → Unity 6 URP Lit:
• Metallic (URP.R) = glTF.B (синий канал)
• Occlusion (URP.G) = glTF.R (красный канал)
• Smoothness (URP.A) = 1.0 − glTF.G (инверсия зеленого)

Ловушка: путаница Roughness и Smoothness в URP Lit делает картинку блеклой.

guide_en.content:
Blender Middleman — the mandatory 5-step AI mesh cleanup:

1. Non-manifold repair: Merge by Distance 0.0001m + remove degenerate faces.
2. Decimation / Quad Remesh: props ≤ 1,000 triangles.
3. Pivot normalization: Origin to Bottom (floor contact, Y = 0).
4. Texture repacking: glTF ORM → Unity URP Lit.
5. glTF export + prefab drag & drop into Unity 6.

SoDog polygon budget:
• Whole scene: ≤ 49,600 tris
• Hero prop: ≤ 4,200 tris
• Standard prop: 250–1,000 tris
• Small interactable: ≤ 250 tris
• Character hero (LOD0): ≤ 8,500 tris

glTF → Unity 6 URP Lit channel formula:
• Metallic (URP.R) = glTF.B (blue channel)
• Occlusion (URP.G) = glTF.R (red channel)
• Smoothness (URP.A) = 1.0 − glTF.G (green inverted)

Trap: mixing up Roughness and Smoothness in URP Lit renders washed out.
